decisions.reason: With Product A withdrawn, B is the firm's remaining two-component injection unit, but it has not been seen on the website since 2019 and the post-2020 construction slowdown may leave it below aspiration, so withdrawal is a real risk even though slack still lets the firm carry it.
Automatic airless guns support pump and system sales in industrial finishing, so the product likely meets aspirations despite its absence from recent website observations.
Manual airless guns are a staple accessory and spare-part item with steady replacement demand, so there is little performance shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
The multi-model air-assisted airless line serves established finishing customers and fits the firm's core application technology, though the line could be trimmed or renamed during model updates.
